features.name: Sticky 10x wilds

review:
The officially licensed Snoop Dogg cluster game. Before each refill, a scatter, wild, weed or skull symbol can be 'dug up', each with its own effect – some clear out low symbols, others boost multipliers.

Cells that keep winning stack 2x multipliers, and wilds stick through refills and the bonus, picking up 10x on marked cells. Three or more scatters give 10, 12, 15 or 20 free spins. There's a four-option bonus buy. Very high volatility, 10,000x max and 96% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus is rare (about 1 in 321 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
